newsitem.title: CHINA: Famous Shanghai products losing market-newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Famous Shanghai products losing market-newspaper.

text.p: Famous Shanghai light industry products including well-know brands produced by listed companies are losing market share to products from other Chinese regions, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.

These include refrigerators produced by Shanghai Shangling Electric Appliances Co, bicycles by Shanghai Phoenix Co and Shanghai Forever Bicycle Co and washing machines by Shanghai Narcissus Electric Appliances Co , the newspaper said.
Falling sales have resulted in Shanghai's light industrial firms performing more poorly than other companies, the newspaper said.
In the first half of this year, listed light industry firms in Shanghai had earnings of only 0.09 yuan per share against 0.14 yuan on average for all listed firms in Shanghai.
